scope: Independent review of all 60 tier-1/2 needs-verification records in three 20-record batches

batches.finding: Unauthorized rephrasings of the frozen 72.4% economics claim appeared outside lupine_proof_point.
batches.remediation: Normalized every 72.4% occurrence to preserve the exact approved wording.

batches.finding: Unauthorized economics rephrasings remained, and P096 incorrectly treated a report as a program/facility.
batches.remediation: Normalized economics and downgraded P096 program/facility plus its mapping to needs-verification in JSON and both renderings.

batches.finding: No record was safely promotable; all 20 required explicit fail-closed treatment while corpus-wide guardrail defects were remediated.
batches.remediation: Preserved all 20 as needs-verification and applied the corpus-wide exact-economics remediation.
